batch.topic: A cook distinguishes chickpeas from green peas and adds only chickpeas to a warm dish; the green peas are reserved for a different dish.
A diner asks for a sauce containing peanuts to be omitted, not merely served separately; allergy prohibition remains explicit and unweakened.
A baker folds beaten egg whites into batter rather than continuing to whisk them separately; preserve what is mixed into what.
A cook reserves a small amount of grated lemon zest but removes the white pith; do not confuse zest with juice.
